# Sitar — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What family is the Sitar in?", "strings"),
    ("How is the Sitar played?", "plucked"),
    ("What is family?", "strings"),
    ("What is origin?", "India"),

]

    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
